rs.innovation_approach: 为视觉和外部知识各训query agent，共享中间attention记忆。
rs.key_step: 先按图距离≤3生成候选词表，actorcritic分别优化答案相似+视觉/外知相似reward。
rs.why_non_obvious: 同一个question query不足以从异质知识源找互补信息。
rs.trigger_condition: When question-only module queries ignore context, select distinct visual and external concepts with shared intermediate memory.
rs.abstract_strategy: 按信息源拆查询，再用状态记忆融合。
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When one query serves incompatible evidence stores, specialize retrieval actions.
